correctness.rationale: For the exact pentagonal wheel forest complex and all dihedral subgroups, every orbit-flag chain group and signed boundary is enumerated, every consecutive differential is zero, and only unit-pivot unimodular cancellations are used. Final integral chain ranks are 1 in degree zero and 6/15/3 in degree four for C5/C2/D5, with no other free or torsion classes. Kook supplies the identity case. The all-spoke simplex barycenter is fixed by every subgroup element, giving pi1=1 by Armstrong; Hurewicz–Whitehead determines the full homotopy type. The actual packaged checker is run and its resulting output examined.

value.rationale: The graphic-matroid complex of the six-vertex pentagonal wheel is a canonical natural object, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its full subgroup quotient integral homotopy type is not determined by a rational/integral top-homology representation when actions have stabilizers. A complete all-eight-subgroups classification and proof of no exotic torsion/attaching maps supplies a reusable benchmark for equivariant matroid topology; no general-wheel theorem is claimed.
